name: 彩棉贴身婴儿和尚服款

category.leaf: 婴儿彩棉和尚服连体衣

description: 彩棉贴身和尚服连体衣，平缝捆条无骨、开档好换洗

styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, cream ivory #F5EFE6 for info and variant layouts, light grey-blue scene floor for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft diffused studio lighting, front-left key with fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cotton-soft flat surface, fluffy ivory rug and light woven mat for lifestyle
styleLock.typography: rounded humanist sans-serif with generous letter spacing
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and dashed circular callout outlines, single caramel accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and gentle scale, garment always fully visible and neatly arranged
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft newborn-underwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm white #FFFFFF, cream ivory #F5EFE6, oat caramel accent #C9A876 and deep coffee text #6B5844; warm soft diffused lighting with gentle contact shadows; rounded humanist sans-serif with generous letter spacing; consistent thin-line icon style; clean airy cotton-soft photography mixed with minimal infographic cards; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and gentle scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的新生儿贴身衣主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, garment laid perfectly flat and centered, full garment visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment laid perfectly flat and centered, straight-on eye-level view, full garment visible with sleeves neatly arranged downward. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no hangers or clips, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传递贴身面料主张，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 flat-lay view, garment placed on the left half
shots.lighting: soft warm front-left key light, gentle contact shadow, 5000K
shots.props: two or three natural cotton bolls and a thin sprig near the lower left, not covering the garment
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the upper right 35% reserved for copy
shots.textZone: upper right headline band plus two blank circular badge outlines near the bottom
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment shown at a slight 3/4 flat-lay view on the left half, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background soft cream ivory #F5EFE6, soft warm front-left key light with a gentle contact shadow. A few natural cotton bolls as props near the lower left, never covering the garment. A headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 sits in the upper right negative space, and two blank thin-outline circular badges near the bottom carry only 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Generous negative space on the upper right 35% reserved for copy. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented material percentages or certification marks inside the badges, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no dense body text.

shots.displayName: 无骨缝制亲肤痛点对比
shots.intent: 放大粗糙缝骨摩擦的不适，反衬平缝捆条的亲肤
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, two matched split panels with identical framing
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light, right panel soft warm light, matched exposure
shots.background: left panel cool light grey #E9EBEE, right panel warm cream #F5EFE6
shots.whitespace: thin center divider, no extra whitespace
shots.textZone: one short label under each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen with two matched panels at a straight-on eye-level view, identical framing and exposure on both sides. Left panel: a tight macro of a rough raised inner seam pressing against soft plain fabric under harsh flat light, conveying friction discomfort, no body or skin shown. Right panel: {product} with a smooth flat bound seam rendered in soft warm light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel background cool light grey #E9EBEE, right panel background warm cream #F5EFE6. A short label 「{callout_1}」 under the left panel and 「{callout_2}」 under the right panel. The garment occupies 50-60% per panel, thin center divider, no extra whitespace. Negative: no baby body or real skin, no fabricated test data or percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用圆形放大位讲清领口、绑带、开档三处结构设计
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay, garment centered
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: three dashed-outline circular zoom callouts with thin leader lines pointing to the neckline, shoulder binding and leg-opening binding
shots.whitespace: even outer margins around the layout, no crowded edges
shots.textZone: one short caption beside each circular callout
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce design-highlight infographic of {product}, top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay with the garment centered, occupying 55-60% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. Background warm cream #F5EFE6. Three dashed-outline circular zoom callouts with thin leader lines highlight the neckline, the shoulder binding and the leg-opening binding, each with a short caption 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」. Even outer margins around the layout, no crowded edges. Negative: no unreadable tiny text, no invented measurements or standards numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered callout lines.

shots.intent: 微距证明织物纹理与捆条工艺的细腻
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the pointelle knit texture and bound edge
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the upper right revealing the raised knit texture, shallow depth of field
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the fabric texture fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the pointelle knit texture and the flat bound edge of the garment. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground texture sharp, soft skimming light from the upper right revealing the raised knit loops. Soft blush beige background #F2E4DC. The fabric detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no stains or discoloration, no pilling artifacts, no extra text, no watermark, no props.

shots.intent: 以空白标注线消除尺码疑虑，数值后期填充
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the flat-laid garment
shots.lighting: even high-key lighting, flat and readable
shots.props: blank dimension lines with end ticks along the body and sleeve, plus an empty spec card on the right
shots.whitespace: clean right column reserved for the spec card
shots.textZone: right column spec card with empty table rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size-guide infographic of {product}, high 45-degree angle looking down at the garment laid flat, occupying 50-60% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key lighting, flat and readable. Background warm white #FFFFFF. Blank dimension lines with end ticks run along the body and sleeve, each ending in an empty label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」; an empty spec card on the right shows empty table rows with no filled values. Clean right column reserved for the spec card. Negative: no invented measurements, numbers or size values anywhere, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 六宫格展示两个色系，让买家按色选择
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, identical framing across all tiles
shots.lighting: identical even soft studio light across every tile
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, tiles evenly spaced
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce color-variant grid of {product}: six identical rectangular tiles in a 3x2 arrangement, straight-on eye-level with identical framing and even soft studio light across every tile. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment appears in two colorways, hex-pinned per tile, for example warm camel #C8B39B and soft sage #C9CFBB, on a cream ivory background #F5EFE6. The garments occupy 60-70% overall, tiles evenly spaced, no extra whitespace. Negative: no mixed lighting between tiles, no invented color names or text labels, no watermark, no fake logo, no texture loss on the lighter tile.

shots.intent: 代入真实居家穿着场景，传递柔软安心的氛围
shots.camera: eye-level documentary view from behind, generic child model wearing the garment, cropped at the neck so no face shows
shots.lighting: soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle shadows
shots.background: light grey-blue soft floor #E4E8EC with a white wood-panel wall
shots.props: a fluffy ivory rug and a floor cushion, not covering the garment
shots.whitespace: soft negative space in the upper third keeps the scene airy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a generic child model seen from behind and cropped at the neck, wearing {product} while standing on a fluffy ivory rug in a bright nursery. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level documentary framing from behind, no face visible. Soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle shadows. Light grey-blue soft floor #E4E8EC with a white wood-panel wall behind. The garment occupies 40-50% of the frame, soft negative space in the upper third keeps the scene airy. Negative: no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no hands covering the garment, no extra text, no watermark, no cluttered props.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用留白按钮位与主张语完成转化
shots.camera: slight 3/4 flat presentation, garment centered on an inner panel
shots.lighting: warm even studio light, slightly punchier key with soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm oat caramel #C9A876 with a soft cream inner panel #F5EFE6
shots.props: one rounded blank CTA button shape at the lower right
shots.whitespace: cream margin band around the inner panel, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment shown at a slight 3/4 flat presentation centered on a soft cream inner panel #F5EFE6, set against a warm oat caramel background #C9A876, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Warm even studio light with a slightly punchier key and a soft contact shadow. A headline 「{selling_point_1}」 across the lower third and one rounded blank CTA button at the lower right carrying only 「{callout_1}」. Cream margin band around the inner panel, no extra whitespace. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdown timers, no fake badges or seals, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 主视觉为彩棉贴身主张、婴儿模特、四枚圆形卖点徽章与棉铃道具；P2 织物点纹微距、五枚圆形特性图标、产品信息卡（原品牌彩棉和尚服套装、新生儿身高段尺码、棕绿双色、柔软/厚度/弹力指数滑杆、洗涤建议与洗护图标）；P3 原平台尺码表与设计亮点三处圆形放大（双重绷带、V领防咯、捆条开档平滑无骨）；P4 颜色分类六宫格平铺；P5-P6 草编圆垫、婴儿鞋、干花、棉铃的浅灰蓝地面平铺展示两屏；P7-P8 领部织物微距重复多屏与白色木纹墙婴儿站立场景（童模面容可辨）；P9 白色绒毯站姿腿脚特写与套装文案。品类判定：尺码为新生儿身高段、开档裆部结构、页面自称内衣定位，属贴身/睡衣类，故改判内衣家居服/儿童内衣而非母婴/童装。已剥离：原品牌与品名字样、童模面容与身份、原文案原句、尺码表实测值、成分含量与洗护温度数值、徽章图标具体图文（一律改为空白占位或 {callout_n}）；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
